detailed_descriptions.en: Alice has stumbled into the Beyond—a fairy-tale world built from cards. Join her as she uncovers new places, meets curious residents, and unravels the town’s secrets in search of a way back to reality. Drag action and item cards onto locations and characters to explore, interact, and solve puzzles. Gather resources, craft useful items, and see what your cards can do. Will you offer a friendly greeting, resort to force, or sneak a crucial item away from an enemy? When trouble blocks your path, try a different approach. Find a way forward with your companions, and keep an eye out for anything that seems out of place. There’s something unsettling beneath this world’s storybook charm. Explore a world of cards, putting your actions and items to use. Uncover secrets and complete quests as you piece together the town’s story. Get caught up in the lives, loves, and rivalries of its quirky residents. Challenge NPCs to a card game along the way. Scan signals for hidden clues. Investigate cases and piece together the evidence. And when all else fails, a little help—and a little luck—might be just what you need.
